title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: Who gets to be captain
hook: Who gets to be captain on your team?
intro: The same two players always lead.
statement: Leading once can change how a kid sees themselves.
q1: Do you rotate captains every game —
q2: or choose captains who lead all season?
q3: Which quiet player might surprise you?
t1: No single answer fits every team. But leaders grow
t2: when more kids get a chance to lead.
cta: Coaches — how do you pick captains?
ctaLines: Rotate weekly. Team vote. Coach picks.
ctaPrompt: Share your captain habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Who gets to be captain on your team?
The same two players always lead. Others never get the chance.
Leading once can change how a kid sees themselves.
Rotate captains or keep the same ones. Every team is different.
How do you pick captains? Share your habit in the comments.
